notes: ① 面板新增「同步内容」卡：把同步到云端的十组内容逐组列出，默认全勾；展开能看到组内明细项，组和单项都能取消勾选。取消后推送不再抓、拉取不再还原，重新勾上就继续同步（推送与拉取共用同一份勾选）。② 勾选记在本机 ~\.dsh\config-sync-scope.json，不进仓库；文件里只留与默认不同的项，删掉即恢复全勾。③ 卡里另有开关「取消勾选时顺手删掉云端副本」，默认关闭：关着时云端那份留着、重新勾上立刻继续；打开后取消勾选会真的删掉仓库里的对应目录（推送时删，另一台机器拉不到），删除不可恢复。④ -PruneSkills 现在不会再把「你勾掉的本机技能」当成多余项删掉；profile 五文件与 mnemon 只做整组开关。
notesEn: (1) New "Sync content" card in the panel: the ten groups that sync to the cloud are listed individually, checked by default; expanding a group shows its items, and both the group and each item can be unchecked. Unchecked content is no longer captured on push and no longer restored on pull — tick it again and syncing resumes (push and pull share the same file). (2) Choices live on this machine in ~\.dsh\config-sync-scope.json and are never committed; the file stores only what differs from the default, so deleting it restores "everything checked". (3) The card carries one more switch, "Also delete the cloud copy when unchecked", off by default: while off the cloud copy stays and re-ticking resumes immediately; when on, unchecking really deletes the matching folder from the repo on the next push (the other machine can no longer pull it), and that deletion cannot be undone. (4) -PruneSkills no longer treats a skill you unchecked as an extra to delete; the five profile files and mnemon are group-level switches only.
